title: Harden dual AI command discipline protocol
objective: Update the dual-AI protocol and prompts so all future AI-B shell commands must be declared in task.commands and every result must be checked with result_checker.py before review.
context: task_0003 created result_checker.py and proved it can catch command drift. Now the standing protocol and both AI prompts must be hardened so Claude generates stricter tasks and Codex refuses undeclared commands.
steps: Validate this task with agent_guard.py before doing anything else.
Read only the three allowed protocol/prompt files.
Update AI_COLLAB_PROTOCOL.md to add a Command Discipline section.
The Command Discipline section must state that all shell commands must be declared in task.commands before execution.
The protocol must state that if AI-B needs an undeclared command, it must stop and request a revised task instead of running the command.
The protocol must state that result_checker.py must pass before AI-A review or before moving to the next task.
Update AI_A_RESEARCH_DIRECTOR.md so Claude must include every command AI-B may run, including JSON validation and result_checker commands, when creating future task JSON files.
Update AI_B_EXECUTION_ENGINEER.md so Codex must refuse undeclared commands and must produce result JSON that stays inside task.allowed_files and task.commands.
Run result_checker.py on task_0004/result_0004 after result JSON is written.
Do not modify source code outside .ai_agents.
success_criteria: AI_COLLAB_PROTOCOL.md contains a Command Discipline section.
AI_A_RESEARCH_DIRECTOR.md instructs Claude to declare every shell command in task.commands.
AI_B_EXECUTION_ENGINEER.md instructs Codex to refuse undeclared commands.
The protocol says result_checker.py must pass before the next task review.
No robot motion script, ROS driver, controller, dataset, checkpoint, rosbag, or secret is accessed.
No source code outside .ai_agents is modified.
stop_conditions: Any command attempts to launch a robot, ROS, controller, or motion script.
Any command attempts to modify source code outside .ai_agents.
Any command attempts to read secrets, datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
A command requires sudo or installs system packages.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
AI-B needs a shell command not listed in task.commands.
